sql: SELECT customer_id, IFNULL(customer_name, 'Unknown') AS customer_name FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, COALESCE(customer_name, 'Unknown') AS customer_name FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id

sql: SELECT employee_id, IFNULL(first_name, 'N/A') AS first_name FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id
expected_sql: SELECT employee_id, COALESCE(first_name, 'N/A') AS first_name FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id

sql: SELECT employee_id, CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS full_name FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id
expected_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id

sql: SELECT employee_id, CONCAT_WS(' ', first_name, last_name) AS full_name FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id
expected_sql: SELECT employee_id, CONCAT_WS(' ', first_name, last_name) AS full_name FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id

sql: SELECT employee_id, LOWER(first_name) AS value FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id

sql: SELECT employee_id, UPPER(last_name) AS value FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id

expected_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN customer_name IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN customer_name = '' THEN 'empty' ELSE 'present' END AS status FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id
